title: Tabula: Scientific presentations
description: Open-source scientific presentation editor running in the browser, with a Linux desktop application in development. Includes LaTeX equations, chemistry, editable charts, local project storage, presenter tools and export workflows. Spanish interface. The current source includes thirteen worked examples (78 slides) with explicitly illustrative data, editable JSON and Beamer sources, interface screenshots, documentation and third-party license notices. This description does not establish that a release package or Zenodo deposit has been published. No production credentials, private research data or cloud service configuration are included.
